"Netcut works by ARP spoofing, which needs layer-2 access to the target network.
In rootless mode the VM sits behind a user-mode NAT (10.0.2.x), so ARP frames never reach the real LAN. Nothing would actually be cut.
To use it here, connect a passed-through USB Wi-Fi adapter to the target network in managed mode, or switch to the rooted engine."

"Couldn't enable monitor mode on %1$s.
Why this happens: • The adapter or its chipset doesn't support monitor mode (most built-in non-Qualcomm Wi-Fi chips don't). • The adapter isn't detected or was unplugged. • The interface is busy or down, or the driver exposes it under a different name.
How to fix: • Settings → Network interfaces: pick a different adapter for handshake/deauth. • Re-plug your external USB Wi-Fi adapter, then rescan. • Use a monitor-capable adapter (e.g. Atheros AR9271, Realtek RTL8812AU / 88XXAU). • Settings → Custom monitor commands: adjust how monitor mode is enabled for your adapter. • Make sure Android Wi-Fi / hotspot isn't holding the interface — toggle it off and try again."
